THIS WP IS FILED UNDER ARTICLE 226 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA R/W SECTION 482 OF CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE 1973 PRAYING TO ALLOW THE PRESENT PETITION AND SET ASIDE THE ORDER AT ANNEXURE-E DATED:19.08.2023 AND PASS AN ORDER ISSUING NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE TO RENEW THE PASSPORT FOR THE PERIOD OF 10 (TEN YEARS) TO THE ACCUSED NO.1 AS HIS PASSPORT BEARING NO X6948321 IS REQUIRED TO BE RENEWED BY THE REGIONAL PASSPORT OFFICE BENGALURU IN S.C.NO.26/2021 FOR OFFENCES PUNISHABLE U/S 498A, 306 AND 34 OF INDIAN PENAL CODE AND SECTION 4 OF DP ACT PENDING BEFORE THE LD. VIII ADDL. DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE, BENGALURU RURAL DISTRICT AT BENGALURU.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
The petitioner is sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 306 read with 34 of IPC.
The petitioner filed an application under Section 6(2) of the NC: 2023:KHC:45932 Passport Act to grant permission for renewal of the subject passport.
The said application came to be rejected.

2. Learned counsel for petitioner submits that petitioner has not violated any of the bail conditions and on an earlier occasion, similar application was filed by the petitioner and it was allowed,
granting permission for renewal of subject passport for a period of one year.

Therefore, the Impugned Order passed by learned Sessions Judge, rejecting the application stating that the application made during the validity of the passport is not maintainable is unsustainable in law.
He further submits that the petitioner's passport is still in substance and the application filed by the petitioner is maintainable.

sentences.text:
3. Heard learned counsel for petitioner and learned HCGP for respondent/State.
4.

On an earlier occasion, learned Sessions Judge by Order dated 30.12.2021 granted no objection certificate for renewal of petitioner's passport for a period of one year and accordingly, the petitioner's passport was renewed and the same is in substance till 05.03.2024.

To obtain Visa, a passport must be valid for a period of more than six months and there is no requirement for the petitioner to await the expiry of the passport to apply for renewal of the said passport.

Hence,
Impugned Order passed by learned Sessions Judge is not sustainable in law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
NC: 2023:KHC:45932 ORDER i. Petition is allowed.
ii. Impugned Order dated 19.08.2023 passed by learned VIII Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Bangaluru Rural District at Bengaluru as regards the application filed under Section 6(2) of the Passport Act, is hereby quashed and the application is allowed.
iii. Petitioner is granted permission for renewal of his passport in accordance with law for a period of five years, subject to petitioner satisfies other requirements.
iv.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is made clear that the passport renewed will not confer any right to the petitioner to travel abroad, without permission of the Trail Court.

Sd/-
